reason: I have 11-20 techs and two locations, a lot of money going through my system every day. I only try something after a friend's salon has used it and told me in the Zalo group. A new app nobody I know uses is not going to touch my payroll and my card money.
objection: I already bought my hardware and I'm set up. Switching costs me: new reader, retraining 15 techs, and if it breaks on a Saturday I lose money. Nobody I know runs it yet.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three salon owners I know personally, running it for a few months, telling me it paid techs right and never lost a ticket. Then I would test it in one location first.
